title: China warns joint US, Philippines and Japan drills risk regional trust
summary: Military cooperation between ​countries should not undermine ​mutual understanding and trust among regional countries, the Chinese foreign ministry said ​on ‌Monday, when ⁠asked about the annual joint ‌military exercises hosted by the Philippines ⁠and the United States that will also involve Japanese ​forces. FRANCE 24's Yena Lee reports from Beijing, China.
